_desc: /resume page — H1 + subtitle + embedded PDF (70vh iframe, rounded border).
_sources: Self-hosted PDF (content/files/ -> public/files/) powers the clean on-page preview. 'driveUrl' is the Google Drive link (same file, verified byte-identical 2026-07-25) opened by the 'View / Download' button so viewers can read or download it in Drive.

_fields.subtitle: Page subtitle (reference UI copy).
_fields.source: 'drive' | 'file' — which source powers the embedded preview.
_fields.driveUrl: Google Drive share URL. Opened by the 'View / Download' button (view + download). If empty, the button downloads the self-hosted file instead.
_fields.file: Public URL path to the self-hosted PDF (content/files/ -> public/files/), e.g. '/files/<name>.pdf'.

subtitle: View and download my professional resume.
